mentions.name: MCP Transactional API Exploration
mentions.description: This experimental project explores the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with Claude as the base LLM, investigating what can be built by plugging transactional APIs into a language model, drawing an analogy to 1990s CGI and envisioning LLMs as the 21st century browsers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Exploring MCP (model context protocol) using Claude as a base LLM. I understand that this is quite new and may change a lot in the next few months but I feel something interesting could be done by plugging transactional APIs to a LLM.
